comments: Uses the real VoiceOver, not a simulation. macOS and Safari only. The warnings point at likely accessible-name problems (WCAG 1.1.1, 2.4.4, 4.1.2); the transcript itself is the main output. Also on npm: https://www.npmjs.com/package/vo-transcript
features: Drives the real macOS VoiceOver screen reader through AppleScript, reads a web page in Safari and saves a transcript of what VoiceOver says. Needs no Full Disk Access and does not change VoiceOver settings. Flags links, buttons and images announced without a name and images read by file name, as hints for manual review. Open source (MIT).
title: vo-transcript
